scope: All Markdown documents under spec, referenced local files and Markdown anchors; explicit sibling fable_merge targets checked. PDF/XLSX embedded links and external websites are not checked.
method: Standard-library scanner excludes fenced/indented code, inline-code spans and HTML comments; resolves inline, defined reference/shortcut and HTML href/src links. Heading slugs remove markup/punctuation and apply duplicate suffixes.
reproduce: Normalize the unmodified 23-Nov-2026/spec/* members from 23-Nov-2026.tar.gz to spec/* in a temporary tar, checking every file hash; run python3 patterns/tools/audit_doc_links.py --baseline /path/to/normalized-23-Nov-spec.tar.gz --output patterns/validation/doc_links_20261123.json --check-new.

baseline.normalization: Only member paths normalized to spec/; file contents match original archive byte for byte. Sibling fable_merge is not part of baseline spec corpus.

historical_repository_external_note: All 15 unresolved repository-external references already occur in the supplied 23-Nov baseline. They point outside this spec packet into the wider original repository and are preserved. No newly broken local file or anchor remains.
